    • sandman2 (⭐2k) - Automated REST APIs for existing database-driven systems.

Web Crawling

  • feedparser (⭐2.3k) - Universal feed parser.
  • mechanicalsoup (⭐4.8k) - A Python library for automating interaction with websites.
  • scrapy (⭐61k) - A fast high-level screen scraping and web crawling framework.

Web Frameworks

  • Synchronous
    • django (⭐87k) - The most popular web framework in Python.
